title: Eric Henry Wang's name on DTIC engineering documents

tellings.quote: yes he no he he existed he existed if you look through the DTick the defense technical information center you can find actual um you can find uh old engineering documents with air Henry weighing on it

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels's podcast that a man named Eric Henry Wang really existed, because his name appears on old 1950s engineering papers linked to Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio. UAPGerb says the papers can be found through DTIC, the Defense Technical Information Center, a US military library of technical reports. The point is that a figure from UFO stories can be traced in real government records.
